description: This file defines the 'Dependant' class used in FastAPI to manage dependencies, including scope, security, and callable properties, with utility functions for call unwrapping and inspection.

classes.name: Dependant
classes.description: Represents a dependency in FastAPI, managing parameters, security, scope, and callable properties, with cached properties for various dependency characteristics.

methods.name: _unwrapped_call
methods.description: Unwraps a possibly wrapped callable to its original form.

methods.name: _impartial
methods.description: Removes partial wrappers from a function to get the original function.
